item.group_name: Composed pieces (several tools, one finished thing)
item.title: One Coffee Ad Three Shapes

turns.text: Make a coffee ad in three sizes: square 1:1, vertical 9:16 and wide 16:9. Use a steaming coffee cup, cream and dark green colours, and these words: “Daybreak Coffee”, “Fresh start. Better coffee.” and “Shop now”. Same campaign design across all three, rearranged to fit.

item.tests: Produces three genuinely adapted aspect-ratio variants of one cohesive ad rather than unrelated designs or cropped copies.

answer_sheet.Brand and exact wording: Daybreak Coffee; Fresh start. Better coffee.; Shop now
answer_sheet.Visual style: Cream and dark green with a steaming coffee cup; one consistent campaign.
answer_sheet.Source assets: No supplied assets; create the coffee imagery.

must_haves: Three separate finished images are supplied, one each in 1:1, 9:16 and 16:9.
All three feature a steaming coffee cup and a consistent cream-and-dark-green palette.
Each image contains the exact brand, headline and call to action specified.
The cup design, typography and visual styling clearly belong to the same campaign across all three images.
Each layout fits its canvas without stretched imagery, clipped copy or large blank padding used merely to change the aspect ratio.

turns.text: I'd like you to make a coffee ad campaign, with three versions that all feel like they belong together. I always associate coffee with a little reset in the morning, which is why I'm excited about this. For the sizes, I need square 1:1, vertical 9:16 and wide 16:9, and the words should be exactly “Daybreak Coffee”, “Fresh start. Better coffee.” and “Shop now”. Please use a steaming coffee cup with cream and dark green colours. Keep the same campaign design across all three, just rearranged to fit each format.
turns.agent:
I couldn’t generate the artwork because Magic Hour reported **insufficient credits**. No images were created or credits spent.

The campaign direction is ready:
- **Consistent design:** cream background, dark green typography and CTA, steaming cream coffee cup, soft morning light and a subtle sunrise emblem.
- **Square 1:1:** headline above the cup, CTA at the lower right.
- **Vertical 9:16:** stacked headline, slogan, cup and CTA with generous spacing.
- **Wide 16:9:** headline, slogan and CTA on the left; cup on the right.

All three will use only your exact wording:
**“Daybreak Coffee”**  
**“Fresh start. Better coffee.”**  
**“Shop now”**

Once credits are available, I can generate the master design and adapt it to the other formats. Magic Hour also notes that commercial use requires a paid subscription, credit-pack purchase or another paid arrangement.

approvals.name: generate_image

style.prompt: Create a polished square 1:1 coffee advertising campaign master artwork. Brand concept: a little reset in the morning, peaceful fresh beginning. Strict two-colour art direction: warm ivory cream #F4EBDD and deep forest dark green #173C31, with natural brown coffee visible. Premium minimalist editorial product photography and elegant typography. Cream background with a subtle morning light glow and soft window shadows. One sculptural cream ceramic coffee cup and matching saucer, filled with coffee, three delicate visible curls of steam, on a dark green tabletop occupying the lower third. Cup positioned in lower middle with plenty of clean space above. Small dark green sunburst sunrise emblem near the brand heading. Top heading in beautiful large readable dark green serif type exactly: "Daybreak Coffee". Beneath, readable dark green clean sans serif slogan exactly: "Fresh start. Better coffee." Bottom right a neat dark green rounded rectangular call-to-action button with cream text exactly: "Shop now". These three strings must be the only text, spelled exactly, no extra words, no quotation marks. Visually balanced professional ad with generous margins and clear hierarchy. Design a cohesive reusable campaign identity, no border, no collage, no watermarks.
